description: This file defines an Angular component `TreeNodeDataViewComponent` that is responsible for rendering node data within a tree structure, including item attributes, short names, tooltips, and chips. It integrates with UI tree utilities and styles, and handles the display logic for tree node items.

classes.name: TreeNodeDataViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for visually representing a tree node's data with conditional display of name, short name, tooltip, and chips.

methods.name: chips
methods.description: Returns an array of chips associated with the item if it's a HierarchyTreeNode; otherwise, returns an empty array.

methods.name: itemShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name of the item if available; otherwise, returns the full name.

methods.name: itemTooltip
methods.description: Provides tooltip content for the item, returning an empty string if the name is a Terminal instance.

methods.name: showShortName
methods.description: Determines whether to display the short name based on item properties.

methods.name: chipClass
methods.description: Generates CSS classes for a chip based on its type.
